categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Supezet Engineering Technology Corp., Ltd. primarily operates in the design, manufacturing, installation, and integrated services of specialized equipment for petroleum refining, petrochemical, and natural gas chemical industries. Its main business segments include petrochemical specialized equipment, refining specialized equipment, EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction) general contracting services, and other products and services. The company has developed a full-process service system covering R&D, product development, manufacturing, intelligent operation, and engineering contracting, achieving comprehensive coverage of refining and chemical integration.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced modular and integrated manufacturing technologies, including proprietary modular cracking furnace technology, rare earth heat-resistant steel furnace tube technology, and intelligent production techniques for heat-resistant steel furnace tubes. It employs digital twin, industrial internet, and smart manufacturing methods to enhance production precision and efficiency. The firm also focuses on green and low-carbon technologies, digital upgrades, and innovative materials development, supported by a robust R&D system with over 290 intellectual property rights including patents and software copyrights.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are primarily large-scale enterprises in the petroleum refining, petrochemical, and natural gas chemical sectors, including major domestic energy companies such as Sinopec and PetroChina. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with products and services covering 27 provinces in China and 16 countries overseas. Its EPC services and specialized equipment cater to large-scale refining and petrochemical projects, including integrated refining and chemical projects.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with significant manufacturing bases in Jiangsu (Jingjiang) and Zhejiang (Daishan), and a headquarters in Shanghai. It has expanded its international presence through subsidiaries and acquisitions, including a wholly-owned subsidiary in Hong Kong and acquisition of Innovare KTI in South Korea, enabling access to markets in Europe, the Middle East, and other regions along the Belt and Road Initiative.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai Supezet Engineering Technology Corp. operates primarily in the midstream to downstream segments of the petrochemical supply chain, focusing on the manufacturing and integration of specialized equipment and EPC services for refining and petrochemical plants. It acts as a key equipment supplier and engineering service provider, bridging upstream raw material processing and downstream chemical production.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic priorities emphasize innovation-driven growth, green development aligned with China's dual carbon goals, global expansion, and industrial collaboration. R&D focuses on new energy equipment technologies such as bio-based energy, green electric heating cracking, hydrogen refining, and waste plastic recycling. It also advances digital technologies including digital twin and industrial internet integration, and develops new materials like specialty polymers and green materials. The firm fosters industry-academia partnerships and invests heavily in modular manufacturing and intelligent operation platforms.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of specialized petrochemical and refining equipment, EPC general contracting services, and related products and services. The company operates on a project-based sales model with customized orders, recognizing revenue upon delivery and acceptance of equipment or completion of EPC projects. It also earns income from engineering consulting, technical services, and after-sales support.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in the specialized petrochemical equipment manufacturing industry, competing with international giants that dominate the high-end market. It holds a significant market share in China and is expanding globally. Its competitive advantages include proprietary core technologies, modular manufacturing capabilities, comprehensive EPC services, and strong customer relationships with major energy companies. The firm is positioned as a comprehensive service provider with growing influence in international markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 2.84 billion, a slight decrease of 4.07% from the previous year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 94.77 million, down 38.46%. Total assets reached RMB 8.71 billion, up 13.86%, with an asset-liability ratio of 69.41%. The company has maintained steady growth with significant investments in R&D (3.99% of revenue) and capital expenditures, supporting its expansion and technological advancement.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shanghai Supezet Engineering Technology Corp. differentiates itself through its integrated full-process service system, combining R&D, modular intelligent manufacturing, and EPC contracting. Its proprietary modular technologies reduce construction labor and costs while improving quality and installation efficiency. The company emphasizes green and low-carbon solutions, digital transformation, and global resource integration, offering customers advanced, customized, and sustainable petrochemical equipment solutions with comprehensive lifecycle services.
